name: extension-validator
description: One-shot pilot for pi extensions. Boots once, drives a given extension's smoke scenario(s) through the Driver SDK (harness/driver/run.ts) against real pi inside tmux, and writes a farewell envelope with the RunReport per scenario plus a magic-wand retrospective. Validates that customType entries survive /compact, status pills render correctly, and the extension's commands behave end-to-end without human input.
author: pij

files.description: Identity, run loop, scenario discovery, Driver-SDK invocation protocol, RunReport aggregation, magic-wand retrospective. Frontmatter declares permissions: trusted, coordination: optional, timeout: 1800 (30m).
Per-scenario validation checklist (boot, run scenarios, aggregate results), evidence required per assertion outcome, when to record a magic-wand wish, when to flag a difficulty candidate.
JSON schema for the validator input: extensionName (required), optional scenarios override array, piBinary, tmuxSession prefix, cwd.

JSON schema for the farewell envelope: { extension, results: RunReport[], summary: { passed, failed, durationMs }, retrospective: { magicWand, magicWandTarget, difficulties[]? }, sessionMetadata }. The results[] shape mirrors RunReport from harness/driver/index.ts verbatim.
